reference.title: Scenario 4 — Code element used for a file path

section.p: Consider an HTML paragraph that contains a file system path wrapped in a <code> element.

table.title: Code element used for a file path

entry.codeblock: The application configuration file is located at C:\Program Files\PrinterApp\config\settings.xml.
The application configuration file is located at C:\Program Files\PrinterApp\config\settings.xml.

section.p: Result: The converter detects that the <code> element contains a file system path pattern and maps it to <filepath> instead of <codeph>.
section.note: A <code> element whose content matches a file-system path pattern, such as directory separators (\ or /), drive letters, directory names, or file names, is mapped to <filepath>. All other <code> content is mapped to <codeph> by default.
